Axis by Tesla

This project explores a futuristic autonomous mobility pod envisioned through concept-driven use of Midjourney and AI-assisted image generation. A series of cinematic visuals place the pod across air, land, and ocean environments, highlighting its adaptability, sleek form, and advanced propulsion. The work demonstrates how AI tools can accelerate speculative transportation design and early-stage visual storytelling.
